The three patient chart components that use `WarningIcon` are all order-basket item tiles, and each renders it only when an order error is present. Nothing in the chart uses `AllergiesIcon`, which is an alias of `WarningIcon` in the framework, so no alias-based usage needs checking.

1. **Medications order basket** renders the icon beside the order error text. It is imported from `@openmrs/esm-framework` and used at `<WarningIcon size={16} />` inside the `orderError` block: @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/drug-order-basket-panel/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx:5-5} and @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/drug-order-basket-panel/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx:87-96}.

2. **Lab tests order basket** uses it the same way for lab order errors: @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-orders/lab-order-basket-panel/lab-order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx:5-5} and @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-orders/lab-order-basket-panel/lab-order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx:42-52}.

3. **General order basket** (`esm-patient-orders-app`) uses it for generic order errors: @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket/general-order-type/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx:5-5} and @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket/general-order-type/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx:34-44}.

The icon is defined in the framework at @file:{openmrs-esm-core::packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx:848-859}, and its mocks are at @file:{openmrs-esm-core::packages/framework/esm-styleguide/mock.tsx:103-103} and @file:{openmrs-esm-core::packages/framework/esm-styleguide/mock-jest.tsx:102-102}. Those mocks only affect tests, not runtime behaviour.

Scope and limits: I only grepped the patient chart checkout locally and searched `openmrs-esm-core` through Falkon. I did not search the other repositories, so consumers outside the patient chart (the date picker and login app in core, for example) are not covered here. Falkon's repository-scoped grep failed with the short names, so I used the full `github.com/openmrs/...` name for the core search. The patient chart search was local, not through Falkon.
